newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungarian O/N rates end weaker, outlook flat.
newsitem.headline: Hungarian O/N rates end weaker, outlook flat.

text.p: Hungarian overnight rates ended slightly below the opening rate and also below Tuesday's close in what dealers called a routine session.
Overnight rates ended at 22.625 percent, down from 22.875 percent at the opening and Tuesday's close of 22.75 percent.
But in one deal, the overnight rates jumped to 23 percent as one bank tapped the market for a bigger amount.
The market's outlook is flat as Thursday's tax payments are unlikely to have a major impact on rates.
"Although there will be tax payments tomorrow, it generally doesn't leave any impact on the market," said Karoly Barath of Postabank.
"Tomorrow's tax payment is not that big, like the one on the 20th (of every month) and the market is liquid," he said.
Barath expected rates to hover between 22.625 percent and 22.875 percent, leaning towards the 22.625 percent this week.
